summary: Gap Tier A / Phase 7 (Inbox, Notifications, Settings, AuditLog, Public Web-Chat) end-to-end testing completed successfully. All backend APIs and frontend features working correctly with only 1 minor API design note.

minor_notes.note: Response doesn't include messages array directly (messages available via GET /api/conversations/{id})
minor_notes.impact: None - this is an API design choice, not a bug

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/login returns {token, user} for owner, ops_admin, driver roles
Backend: RBAC - driver gets 403 on /api/conversations (CRM section) and /api/settings
Backend: RBAC - owner and ops_admin can access /api/conversations
Backend: GET /api/conversations returns list with filters (status, assigned, channel, q)
Backend: POST /api/conversations creates conversation with optional first message
Backend: GET /api/conversations/{id} returns conversation with messages array
Backend: PATCH /api/conversations/{id} updates status (open/snoozed/closed)
Backend: PATCH /api/conversations/{id} validates assigned_to (returns 400 for invalid agent)
Backend: POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages posts agent reply (internal=false, status=delivered)
Backend: POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages posts internal note (internal=true, status=sent)
Backend: POST /api/conversations/{id}/read marks customer messages read and unread=0
Backend: GET /api/notifications returns list, GET /api/notifications?status=pending filters correctly
Backend: GET /api/notifications/unread_count returns {count}
Backend: POST /api/notifications/scan (owner/ops only) returns {created}, driver gets 403
Backend: POST /api/notifications/read_all, POST /api/notifications/{id}/read, POST /api/notifications/{id}/dismiss working
Backend: Notification role visibility - driver sees only driver/all notifications, not manager
Backend: GET /api/settings (owner only) returns all keys (company_info, pricing_defaults, operational, pricing_rules, map_provider, theme_config)
Backend: PATCH /api/settings updates company_info and pricing_defaults, changes persist
Backend: Settings changes create audit log entries
Backend: GET /api/audit-logs (owner only) returns list of audit entries, ops_admin and driver get 403
Backend: POST /api/public/chat creates web channel conversation (no auth)
Backend: POST /api/public/chat with token continues conversation
Backend: GET /api/public/chat/{token} returns public thread with internal notes hidden
Backend: Public web-chat conversation appears in agent Inbox with channel=web
Frontend: Inbox page (/app/inbox) renders with conversation list (4 conversations found)
Frontend: Inbox search input and filter buttons (all, unassigned, mine) working
Frontend: Inbox thread view opens, displays messages with correct styling
Frontend: Inbox message composer, send button, internal note toggle working
Frontend: Inbox can send agent reply and internal note successfully
Frontend: Inbox assign dropdown and status dropdown working, can change status to snoozed
Frontend: NotificationBell in topbar shows dropdown with 7 notifications
Frontend: NotificationBell 'Read all', 'Mark read', 'Dismiss' buttons working
Frontend: Settings page (/app/settings) renders all sections (Company, Pricing, Pricing Rules, Operational)
Frontend: Settings can edit company name and save, changes persist after reload
Frontend: AuditLog page (/app/auditlog) renders with filters (search, entity type, action)
Frontend: AuditLog table displays audit entries including settings changes
Frontend: Public web-chat FAB visible on public site, opens chat panel
Frontend: Public web-chat first-time user flow (name/phone inputs) working
Frontend: Public web-chat can send messages, conversation appears in agent Inbox
